avisos.texto: This follows the Qatar Labour Law. It doesn't cover government staff, the armed forces and police, seafarers, state oil and gas companies, casual workers, domestic workers, farm workers or part-time and freelance workers, who have their own rules.

fuente.organismo: Al Meezan, Qatar Legal Portal (Ministry of Justice)
fuente.titulo: Law No. 9 of 2026 amending the Labour Law (new Article 3)
